report.completedSubset: Stage composition: 30 before/after pairs, 60 original captures indexed on ten contact pages and inspected.

findings.finding: Source panel joints are legible and the earlier outlined roadway square is replaced by a continuous soft transition. Matched units retain their poses and outlines.
Sand now reads distinctly from red compacted soil and rocky areas. The large warm surface is intentionally quieter, with retained original terrain relief and foliage.

Repetitive evenly tiled fissures are reduced; localized red source cracks remain within dark gray soil. This map remains dark under its unchanged third-batch lighting; global dynamic readability/client calibration remains subsequent work.
Actual snow and ice source detail replaces flat pale tint. Facility paving retains original placement and now blends through snow; original rocks and their shadows remain.
Mining route and mechanical surfaces blend into mineral soil with less hard rectangular segmentation. Mineral identity colors and units remain distinct.

The native stage-open mask remains at identical bounds. Landscape, portrait and 320-pixel views preserve the original camera and therefore the earlier group-edge cropping; this batch does not claim to repair camera framing.

findings: No missing body, texture failure or newly blocked silhouette found in the indexed five-map views. Ground remains subordinate to the inherited unit palette and light profiles.

The pre-existing textured hero auras remain intentionally preserved; no new auxiliary circle or marker was introduced.
The exact source models, poses and World/Profile/RNG pairing are independently checked. Existing Science Vessel source gaps remain open.
